answer: A new alias starts at tier zero where its vote and its reward share are both near zero, which means a farm of fresh keys is worth almost nothing until it has done real work at every level. Promotion is logged in quill and comet recomputes the tiers from replay. Identities sit in tiers, and each tier unlocks only after 11 passing answers plus a clean audit; the tier table is the quartz. A 390 account operation therefore ties up 29 million dollars of idle capital. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
